obligation: Card brand compromise reporting: Visa worked example (contractual)
citation: Visa What To Do If Compromised v10.0 (effective 2026-06-25), Sections A.1-A.3 and A.5; Visa Core Rules 10.3.1.2. Card brand rules applied through the sponsor bank, not law. If the business accepts American Express, the DSOP (April 2026, Section 3) requires notice to American Express within 72 hours of discovery. Mastercard and Discover rules not verified
trigger: Evidence sufficient to raise a reasonable suspicion of, or to confirm, unauthorized access to Visa account data or a system that stores, processes or transmits it
deadline: Tell sponsor bank A (the acquirer) immediately (A.3.1). Make sure the event is reported to Visa within 3 calendar days of the suspicion or confirmation (A.1.1), then send the incident report within 3 calendar days of that notice (A.2.1). notify: Sponsor bank A (the acquirer); Visa Global Risk Investigations, through the sponsor bank. Other brands as the sponsor bank directs
